package domain

const MaximumGeneratedCoursePayloadBytes = 16 << 20

type CourseStatus string

const (
	CourseStatusActiveBuilding CourseStatus = "ACTIVE_BUILDING"
	CourseStatusActive         CourseStatus = "ACTIVE"
)

type LessonStatus string

const (
	LessonStatusPlanned          LessonStatus = "PLANNED"
	LessonStatusGenerating       LessonStatus = "GENERATING"
	LessonStatusActive           LessonStatus = "ACTIVE"
	LessonStatusGenerationFailed LessonStatus = "GENERATION_FAILED"
	LessonStatusArchived         LessonStatus = "ARCHIVED"
)

type PlannedLesson struct {
	Code                string                `json:"code"`
	Title               string                `json:"title"`
	Excerpt             string                `json:"excerpt"`
	Order               int                   `json:"order"`
	Status              LessonStatus          `json:"status"`
	Targets             []TargetRef           `json:"targets"`
	Prerequisites       []TargetRef           `json:"prerequisites"`
	TransitionKnowledge []TransitionKnowledge `json:"transition_knowledge,omitempty"`
	PedagogyStrategies  []PedagogyStrategyRef `json:"pedagogy_strategies"`
	DescriptionMarkdown string                `json:"description_markdown"`
	Examples            []PlannedExample      `json:"examples"`
	Tasks               []PlannedTask         `json:"tasks"`
}

type PlannedExample struct {
	Title               string   `json:"title"`
	DescriptionMarkdown string   `json:"description_markdown"`
	PrimaryStack        string   `json:"primary_stack,omitempty"`
	Stacks              []string `json:"stacks"`
	TargetConcepts      []string `json:"target_concepts"`
}

type PlannedTask struct {
	Title               string   `json:"title"`
	DescriptionMarkdown string   `json:"description_markdown"`
	ExpectedAnswers     []string `json:"expected_answers"`
}

type PlannedSection struct {
	Code    string          `json:"code"`
	Title   string          `json:"title"`
	Order   int             `json:"order"`
	Lessons []PlannedLesson `json:"lessons"`
}

type PlannedModule struct {
	Code     string           `json:"code"`
	Title    string           `json:"title"`
	Order    int              `json:"order"`
	Sections []PlannedSection `json:"sections"`
}

type GeneratedCourse struct {
	Fingerprint        string          `json:"course_fingerprint"`
	FingerprintVersion string          `json:"fingerprint_version"`
	GoalCode           string          `json:"goal_code"`
	GoalVersion        string          `json:"goal_version"`
	Title              string          `json:"title"`
	Description        string          `json:"description"`
	Language           string          `json:"language"`
	Status             CourseStatus    `json:"status"`
	CatalogVisible     bool            `json:"catalog_visible"`
	PlannerVersion     string          `json:"planner_version"`
	PedagogyProfile    string          `json:"pedagogy_profile"`
	PresentationStyle  string          `json:"presentation_style"`
	GenerationPolicy   string          `json:"generation_policy"`
	Modules            []PlannedModule `json:"modules"`
}

type EnsureCourseResult struct {
	CourseID string                `json:"course_id"`
	Reused   bool                  `json:"reused"`
	Lessons  []CourseLessonBinding `json:"lessons"`
}

type CourseLessonBinding struct {
	LessonRevisionID string      `json:"lesson_revision_id,omitempty"`
	LessonID         string      `json:"lesson_id"`
	Order            int         `json:"order"`
	Targets          []TargetRef `json:"targets"`
}
